people.name: Marcos G. Montero González

previously: Interim Executive Director, Museo de Arte de Ponce
Chief Operating Officer, Museo de Arte de Ponce
Associate Deputy Director and Director of Development and Communications, Museo de Arte de Ponce

basis: The museum's own news page reports that the board of the Fundación Luis A. Ferré named Marcos G. Montero González executive director after he served as interim executive director, and it links an El Nuevo Día article of 25 January 2026 on his appointment; neither names his predecessor.

Beta-Local's Form 990 for the fiscal year ending June 2025 (filed 6 May 2026), shown on ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer, lists Michael Linares and Pablo Guardiola as co-directors and Marilucy Gonzalez Baez as president of the board; the space's own about page names no people.

The museum's Form 990 for the fiscal year ending June 2025 (filed 15 May 2026), shown on ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer, lists Marianne Ramirez Aponte as executive director; the museum's own site could not be reached.

basis: Qatar Museums' own leadership page names Mohammed Saad Al Rumaihi as chief executive officer since June 2023 and Sheikha Al Mayassa bint Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani as chairperson since the founding in 2005; it does not name the previous chief executive.
The museum's own list of people in management posts (page updated 2 November 2026) names Cornel Constantin Ilie as manager; no page opened gives his start date or names a predecessor.

The space's own about page lists Alexandra Croitoru and Magda Radu first in its team, and its exhibition page for the show of 9 October to 22 November 2026 names both as curators; no page states a director title.
The foundation's own about page (Despre noi) lists Georgia Bacinschi as director, Diana Marincu as artistic director and Ovidiu Șandor as president; it gives no start dates.

An RBC Style feature of 30 May 2025 on the centre's team names the publisher and curator Kirill Maevsky as a co founder of Smena and quotes him on its current work; the centre's own site could not be found.
